commit.message:
Add never_in Bacilli to GO:0009103 lipopolysaccharide biosynthetic process (#32938) (#32940)

* Add never_in Bacilli to GO:0009103 lipopolysaccharide biosynthetic process (#32938)

Bacilli have a single (monoderm) membrane and no LPS outer membrane. The
diderm, LPS-producing Firmicutes are Negativicutes, Halanaerobiales and
Limnochordia (PMID:27580370, PMID:33077930), so the constraint is set at
Bacilli (NCBITaxon:91061), not Bacillota. Streptococcaceae, named in the
issue, is inside Bacilli.

Bacilli had no materialized taxon constraint class, so add it to
imports/taxon_constraints_seed.txt. imports/go-taxon-constraint-classes.ofn
still has to be regenerated (ODK not available where this was made).

Fixes #32938

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Regenerate go-taxon-constraint-classes.ofn for neverin:91061 (Bacilli)

Ran `make imports/go-taxon-constraint-classes.ofn` in the ODK container
after NCBITaxon:91061 was added to taxon_constraints_seed.txt. Adds the
never-in/only-in Bacilli class definitions (EquivalentClasses etc.) so the
is_a neverin:91061 on GO:0009103 takes effect. No unrelated changes.
`make travis_test` passes.

Refs #32938, #32940
